title: ferrovue.config.json
description: What `ferrovue.config.json` holds. Paths are relative to the project root.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks the file against. ferrovue does not read it.
$schema.markdownDescription: The JSON Schema an editor checks the file against. ferrovue does not read it.

components.description: The directory of `.vue` files to compile.
components.markdownDescription: The directory of `.vue` files to compile.

out.description: The directory the Rust modules are written to. A module ferrovue wrote there is replaced or removed; any other file is left alone.
out.markdownDescription: The directory the Rust modules are written to. A module ferrovue wrote there is replaced or removed; any other file is left alone.

helpers.description: The module components import their helpers from, and the Rust twin of each export.
helpers.markdownDescription: The module components import their helpers from, and the Rust twin of each export.

module.description: The module a component imports the helpers from, as its imports name it: `./helpers`.
module.markdownDescription: The module a component imports the helpers from, as its imports name it: `./helpers`.

functions.description: Each function a template may call, by its name in that module.
functions.markdownDescription: Each function a template may call, by its name in that module.

rust.description: The Rust path the generated code calls, e.g. `crate::helpers::format_count`.
rust.markdownDescription: The Rust path the generated code calls, e.g. `crate::helpers::format_count`.

params.description: The type of each argument, in order.
params.markdownDescription: The type of each argument, in order.

maxLen.description: The longest string it returns, which is what a call adds to the buffer reservation.
maxLen.markdownDescription: The longest string it returns, which is what a call adds to the buffer reservation.

twins.description: Components ferrovue does not compile, by the name a template gives them (`VBtn`, which `<v-btn>` finds too), each rendered by a Rust function of the project's.
twins.markdownDescription: Components ferrovue does not compile, by the name a template gives them (`VBtn`, which `<v-btn>` finds too), each rendered by a Rust function of the project's.

rust.description: The Rust path the generated parent calls, e.g. `crate::ui::v_btn`.
rust.markdownDescription: The Rust path the generated parent calls, e.g. `crate::ui::v_btn`.

props.description: Each prop a template may pass it, by its name in Vue, with its type.
props.markdownDescription: Each prop a template may pass it, by its name in Vue, with its type.

slots.description: The slots a template may fill, by name: `["default", "prepend"]`.
slots.markdownDescription: The slots a template may fill, by name: `["default", "prepend"]`.

trustedHtml.description: The Rust type a `TrustedHtml` prop is, which must implement `ferrovue::TrustedHtml`, e.g. `crate::sanitize::SafeHtml`. A type that borrows names the props' lifetime, `'a`: `crate::render::Trusted<'a>`. `ferrovue::InlineHtml` makes every `TrustedHtml` prop inline HTML. Without it, only an `InlineHtml` prop may reach `v-html`.
trustedHtml.markdownDescription: The Rust type a `TrustedHtml` prop is, which must implement `ferrovue::TrustedHtml`, e.g. `crate::sanitize::SafeHtml`. A type that borrows names the props' lifetime, `'a`: `crate::render::Trusted<'a>`. `ferrovue::InlineHtml` makes every `TrustedHtml` prop inline HTML. Without it, only an `InlineHtml` prop may reach `v-html`.

routes.description: A JSON file listing the app's routes as vue-router paths (`/users/:id`), which `<RouterLink>` resolves against, or `{ pages }`: a folder of pages whose file names give the routes, as vue-router's file-based routing reads them. Without it, a component cannot use `<RouterLink>`.
routes.markdownDescription: A JSON file listing the app's routes as vue-router paths (`/users/:id`), which `<RouterLink>` resolves against, or `{ pages }`: a folder of pages whose file names give the routes, as vue-router's file-based routing reads them. Without it, a component cannot use `<RouterLink>`.

pages.description: The folder of pages, each a component, whose file names give the routes.
pages.markdownDescription: The folder of pages, each a component, whose file names give the routes.

router.description: The router, in full: its routes, the history's base, and the class names `createRouter` gives active links. `routes` alone is shorthand for `{ routes }`.
router.markdownDescription: The router, in full: its routes, the history's base, and the class names `createRouter` gives active links. `routes` alone is shorthand for `{ routes }`.

routes.description: Where the routes come from, as `routes` takes them.
routes.markdownDescription: Where the routes come from, as `routes` takes them.

pages.description: The folder of pages, each a component, whose file names give the routes.
pages.markdownDescription: The folder of pages, each a component, whose file names give the routes.

base.description: The base `createWebHistory` is given, which every link starts with.
base.markdownDescription: The base `createWebHistory` is given, which every link starts with.

linkActiveClass.description: The class of a link to the current route or one of its parents.
linkActiveClass.markdownDescription: The class of a link to the current route or one of its parents.

linkExactActiveClass.description: The class of a link to exactly the current route.
linkExactActiveClass.markdownDescription: The class of a link to exactly the current route.

stores.description: The directory of Pinia stores (`.ts` files), whose state a component may read while it renders on the server.
stores.markdownDescription: The directory of Pinia stores (`.ts` files), whose state a component may read while it renders on the server.

clientDirectives.description: Custom directives that render nothing on the server (no `getSSRProps`), by name, without `v-`: `["focus", "click-outside"]`. Any other custom directive is refused, since the server cannot know what its `getSSRProps` would add.
clientDirectives.markdownDescription: Custom directives that render nothing on the server (no `getSSRProps`), by name, without `v-`: `["focus", "click-outside"]`. Any other custom directive is refused, since the server cannot know what its `getSSRProps` would add.

i18n.description: vue-i18n: the directory of locale files (`en.json`, `nl.json`), the locale a page renders in when it names none, and the locales a missing message falls back to.
i18n.markdownDescription: vue-i18n: the directory of locale files (`en.json`, `nl.json`), the locale a page renders in when it names none, and the locales a missing message falls back to.

messages.description: The directory of locale files, one per locale: `en.json`, `nl.json`.
messages.markdownDescription: The directory of locale files, one per locale: `en.json`, `nl.json`.

locale.description: The locale a page renders in when it names none.
locale.markdownDescription: The locale a page renders in when it names none.

fallbackLocale.description: The locale or locales, in order, a message missing from the page's locale is looked up in.
fallbackLocale.markdownDescription: The locale or locales, in order, a message missing from the page's locale is looked up in.

scopeId.description: How a `<style scoped>` component's `data-v-` id is computed, which must be how `@vitejs/plugin-vue` computes it for the client: from the file's path (`"filepath"`, the plugin's choice in development, and with `features.componentIdGenerator: "filepath"`), or its path and source (`"filepath-source"`, the plugin's choice for a production build).
scopeId.markdownDescription: How a `<style scoped>` component's `data-v-` id is computed, which must be how `@vitejs/plugin-vue` computes it for the client: from the file's path (`"filepath"`, the plugin's choice in development, and with `features.componentIdGenerator: "filepath"`), or its path and source (`"filepath-source"`, the plugin's choice for a production build).

viteRoot.description: Vite's root, from which a scope id hashes a component's path: the project root by default.
viteRoot.markdownDescription: Vite's root, from which a scope id hashes a component's path: the project root by default.

isProduction.description: Whether `@vitejs/plugin-vue` compiles for production, as Vite's `isProduction`: `true` (the default) for `vite build`, `false` for the dev server. It decides the names of the CSS variables `v-bind()` in `<style>` sets: a hash in production, the expression in development.
isProduction.markdownDescription: Whether `@vitejs/plugin-vue` compiles for production, as Vite's `isProduction`: `true` (the default) for `vite build`, `false` for the dev server. It decides the names of the CSS variables `v-bind()` in `<style>` sets: a hash in production, the expression in development.

cssModules.description: CSS modules (`<style module>`): how Vite's `css.modules` names their classes, which ferrovue computes as postcss-modules does. Without it, `<style module>` is refused.
cssModules.markdownDescription: CSS modules (`<style module>`): how Vite's `css.modules` names their classes, which ferrovue computes as postcss-modules does. Without it, `<style module>` is refused.

generateScopedName.description: The pattern of a class's name, as Vite's `css.modules.generateScopedName`: `"[local]_[hash:base64:5]"`.
generateScopedName.markdownDescription: The pattern of a class's name, as Vite's `css.modules.generateScopedName`: `"[local]_[hash:base64:5]"`.

hashPrefix.description: Vite's `css.modules.hashPrefix`, hashed before a module's path.
hashPrefix.markdownDescription: Vite's `css.modules.hashPrefix`, hashed before a module's path.

context.description: The directory Vite runs in, its working directory, from which a hash takes a module's path, relative to this file's directory: `viteRoot` by default.
context.markdownDescription: The directory Vite runs in, its working directory, from which a hash takes a module's path, relative to this file's directory: `viteRoot` by default.

builders.description: Whether each props struct and shared type gets `new()` and a chainable setter per optional field: `true` by default. With `false`, props are built as struct literals.
builders.markdownDescription: Whether each props struct and shared type gets `new()` and a chainable setter per optional field: `true` by default. With `false`, props are built as struct literals.
